Hi Eden —

Appreciate the details and the PDF. High-level answers so we can scope this quickly: 

- Schema: yes, our operator_action export includes the fields you listed (actor_id, action_type, target_id, timestamp_utc, before/after_snapshot as JSON blob, session_id, source_ip, region, service, request_id, trace_id, user_agent). We can also include escalation_reason and admin_role on demand.
- Retention: default admin-action retention is 14 months for hosted customers. We offer an enterprise retention add-on (archive to a customer-owned S3 with 7-years retention) for customers with longer regulatory needs.
- Exports & manifests: we support JSONL and CSV exports. Exports are normalized to UTC; timezone conversions are applied in the pipeline. Every export includes a signed manifest (SHA256 + HMAC using a key tied to the account) and an MD5/SHA checksum for each file.
- SLAs: standard on-demand extract lead time is 48 hours (business hours). Expedited extracts (8–12 hours) are supported as a billable service for enterprise customers with an emergency agreement — needs approval from Compliance and Ops.

Limitations / notes: PII redaction is available but must be specified in the request (field-level redaction rules). We do not support arbitrary retroactive redaction; redaction is applied at export time and may affect the ability to reconstruct pre-redaction state for forensics. Exports are rate-limited and segmented (max 500k events per file) to keep performance predictable.

I attached a short Export Options summary (formats, encryption, HMAC behavior). Marissa (cc'd) will follow up with the sample manifest and operational playbook.

Want to set up a 30-min call with Bluewater + their auditor to walk through the manifest and sample output?

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Hi Eden / Matt —

Thanks for the request. Attaching a manifest template and a short operator_action schema CSV. Highlights and playbook items below:

- Export manifest: includes export_id, account_id, files[], file_checksums (SHA256), export_timestamp_utc, requestor, signed_by (redwood-key-id), hmac_signature. See attached template: bluewater_extract_manifest_template.jsonl
- Field-level notes: timestamps are normalized to UTC and stored as ISO8601 with offset Z. before/after snapshots are included as compressed JSON blobs (base64 in CSV exports).
- Transfer: For standard extracts we stage files to an encrypted S3 bucket (customer-owned if requested). Transfers are done over TLS with KMS-encrypted objects. The manifest and all files are HMAC-signed; we provide the HMAC pub info in the manifest.
- SLA & cadence: 48 business hours for standard on-demand. Expedited 8–12 hours requires a prepaid emergency extract and compliance sign-off; we run these during the defined window and escalate Ops on call.

Caveats: PII redaction removes or masks fields but will be logged in the manifest as redaction_applied=true; note that redaction may break exact pre/post state comparisons. Sampling is supported for very large datasets but must be requested upfront.

Attachments included: bluewater_extract_manifest_template.jsonl, operator_action_schema_v1.csv

Next steps: If you confirm format (JSONL primary, CSV as supplemental) and sign the emergency-extract addendum (linked), we will schedule a sample extract and upload to s3://redwood-evidence/bluewater/20261101/ for your team to validate.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Lead, Compliance Evidence & Audit Programs
Redwood Inference
